text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab newspapers and personalities denounce U.S. media campaign against Iraq.
- Kuwaiti officials try to allay fears of their own people emanating from their own lies.
- Former Kuwaiti minister criticises Washington over allegations on presence of Iraqi troops near Kuwaiti border.
- Iraq protests against flights by U.S. and British warplanes over its territory.
- Iraq's Rafidain Bank resumes normal activities in Bahrain.
- France stresses policy of non-interference in Algerian affairs.
- Iraq holds music festival in Cairo.
- Egypt to ship $2.9 million worth of medical supplies to Iraq this month under oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq doubles trips by fleet of tankers carrying Iraqi crude to Jordan.
